TOUCH_EDITOR.DESCRIPTION: Create a scheduled touch for this record. Channel resolution and final status are handled by the touch engine.

TEXT_AUTHOR_HELP.SELF: Write the final text yourself. Liquid variables {{...}}, {%...%} tags, and field:// references are detected automatically.
TEXT_AUTHOR_HELP.AGENT: The AI agent will generate the message at execution time from your instructions and the current context.

REPEAT_MODE_HELP.ONCE: The touch will run only once at the selected time.
REPEAT_MODE_HELP.DAILY: After each successful execution, the next touch will be scheduled for the same time on the following day.
REPEAT_MODE_HELP.WEEKLY: After each successful execution, the next touch will be scheduled for the same weekday and time in the following week.
REPEAT_MODE_HELP.WEEKDAYS: After each successful execution, the next touch will be scheduled for the next business day at the same time.
REPEAT_MODE_HELP.MONTHLY: After each successful execution, the next touch will be scheduled for the same day and time in the next month.

TIMING_MODE_HELP.ABSOLUTE: Use an exact send time when the follow-up should fire on a fixed schedule.
TIMING_MODE_HELP.RELATIVE: Use the record timeline so the touch keeps following appointment, task, deal, or conversation changes.

TOUCH_EDITOR.ROUTING_NOTE: The system will reuse the current conversation when possible and otherwise resolve the target route at execution time. If a route cannot be resolved, the touch stays in draft instead of sending blindly.

FIELDS.ENTITY_NOTE: Choose the record this touch belongs to. Conversation touches can be created directly here; other record types may remain draft until route resolution is complete.
FIELDS.BODY_PLACEHOLDER: Write the message that should be sent later
FIELDS.TEMPLATE_EMPTY: No WhatsApp templates are available for this inbox yet.
FIELDS.TEMPLATE_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Sync templates for the current WhatsApp inbox or switch back to free text.
FIELDS.BODY_NOTE: If the message contains {{...}}, {%...%}, or field:// references, template mode will be detected automatically.
FIELDS.INSTRUCTIONS_PLACEHOLDER: Describe what message the AI agent should generate when this touch runs
FIELDS.RELATIVE_OFFSET_NOTE: Use a value greater than 0 minutes.
FIELDS.RELATIVE_FIXED_TIME_DESCRIPTION: The date will still be calculated before/after the anchor, but the touch will run at the selected time on that day.
FIELDS.AUTO_CANCEL_DESCRIPTION: If the contact replies in the same channel before execution, the touch will be cancelled automatically.
FIELDS.FREE_TEXT_TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDER: Select a saved free text template

TEXT_MODE_HELP.STATIC: Use this mode when the message should be sent exactly as saved.
TEXT_MODE_HELP.DYNAMIC: Use field references when the final text should be resolved from the current record at send time.
TEXT_MODE_HELP.AGENT: Use AI agent instructions when the final text should be generated at execution time from the current conversation and record context.
